name: signup_id
description: SU and the row's Excel row number on Account signups, e.g. SU0012. It changes if rows are inserted above.

name: employer_id
description: The employer (dim_employer), or NULL when the source row names none.

name: signup_month
description: First day of the sign-up month (the sheet records only the month). NULL when the row has no month.

name: role
description: Job role typed on the row. NULL when blank, or when it repeated the organisation's name.

name: survey_flag
description: 'Completed survey?' read as yes or no. NULL when the text can't be read.

name: survey_dates
description: Months named in the 'Completed survey?' text, as first-of-month dates (YYYY-MM-DD) separated by ';'.

name: was_flag
description: 'Requested WAS?' read as yes or no. NULL when the text can't be read.

name: was_dates
description: Months named in the 'Requested WAS?' text, as first-of-month dates (YYYY-MM-DD) separated by ';'.
